cardOverview.overviewText: An entertainment-first lifestyle card that provides cashback and discounts on movies, dining, and OTT subscriptions, making it ideal for young, experience-driven users.

benefitRows.name: Ajio
benefitRows.offer: Get upto ₹1000 off on spending ₹2999 using "AJIOAXISMZ".
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to your Ajio account and apply your Axis My Zone credit card details or promo codes during checkout to redeem exclusive shopping discounts and offers. Contact Axis Bank customer care at 1860 419 5555 for queries.

benefitRows.name: District
benefitRows.offer: Buy 1 movie ticket and get 1 for free upto ₹200 Monthly.|Valid once per month
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, visit the District events website or app and sign up using your registered account. Apply your Axis My Zone credit card details during booking to unlock exclusive discounts and priority access to movies and events. Contact Axis Bank support at 1860 419 5555 for assistance.
